files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Fixed

- restore color-scheme pins and heal stale check-shell contracts
- surface server 409 reason for entitlement-linked absence types
- scope get-the-app Login Flow claim to the mobile companion
- formal Sie-register cell for license signature callout (de)
- repoint orphan token refs after check-shell tokens sync
- doorConfig reads group door via platform restriction
- nb/pl truncated catalog values — dropped tails + terminal punct
- ru accusative case + esteem-calque cells (r74)
- heal ru round-5 wart cells — splice non-word, agreement, wrong-sense (r73)
- fr — embed localized label in Badges & PIN dep
- heal multi-locale semantic corruption + tr pluralForm — web round 4 (r72)
- heal Russian catalog semantic corruption — web round 3 (r71)
- heal Russian catalog semantic corruption — web round 2 (r70)
- heal Russian catalog semantic corruption (r69)
- heal ru catalog gate findings + serialize shared-state e2e specs
- auto clock-out audit hardening
- re-sync pack + manifest auto_clockout keys
- auto clock-out scope error names localized labels
- breakdown dialog honors Escape despite NC notifications

### Added

- AzcOrgReadFacade for ExpenseCheck suite reads + config-transfer re-sync
- add Russian (ru) catalog
- auto clock-out at planned end-of-day

### Changed

- define --azc-mono + muted-on-tint tokens (check-shell sync)
- 1.12.1 — record multi-locale catalog heal
- re-sync config-transfer pack (docblock generics + null guard)
- l10n(de): say Freizeitausgleich instead of Gleittag
- l10n: formal register + identical-gap cleanup, zh_TW vocabulary flip
- atlas auto clock-out job lifecycle probes
- e2e guard for breakdown dialog open/load/Escape close

## Unreleased

### Fixed

- **custom absence types admin showed a generic failure when deleting a
  type linked to a special leave entitlement** (CECILIENSTIFT report):
  the server correctly refused with 409 + a translated reason, but the
  UI discarded it and showed only "Failed to delete the absence type".
  Linked types are now marked in the list ("Linked absence type"), the
  toggle/delete actions are replaced by a direct link to the entitlement
  administration, the editor's availability checkbox is disabled with an
  explanatory note, and every error path surfaces the server's real
  message (including field-level validation errors on 400 bodies).
- **masked server error reasons on manager actions (same class):**
  approving/rejecting an absence or a substitution request, and saving
  the "use app teams" setting, could only ever say "Failed" even when
  the server explained why (e.g. "already decided by another manager").
  These handlers now surface the server's message with the generic text
  as fallback.
- **native form controls could follow the OS theme instead of the
  Nextcloud theme**: the shared token sync dropped the explicit
  `color-scheme` pins, so a light Nextcloud on a dark OS could paint
  dark checkboxes/scrollbars (and vice versa). The pins are restored in
  the shared check-shell pack and re-synced.
- **Russian holidays legend quoted labels that did not match the
  rendered dropdown options**; the legend now quotes the real labels.
- **Polish substitution copy used the formal "Państwa" register** while
  the rest of the catalog addresses the user informally; aligned.
- **Norwegian Bokmål cross-language lint** now recognises `overført` as a
  legitimate shared Danish/Norwegian token instead of flagging it as
  bleed.
